summary: Read Perplexity browser cookies from the account host and send the browser API version/source parameters on history endpoints.
reason: Chrome stores Perplexity's account-session cookies on www.perplexity.ai, while the CLI previously extracted from perplexity.ai and saved only edge/challenge cookies. That made recent/read/export calls look authenticated to Cloudflare but unauthenticated to Perplexity. The browser app also sends version=2.18 and source=default on the history APIs.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli ./internal/client ./internal/config ./internal/store passes; auth login --chrome saves account-session cookies; history recent/read/export succeed against a logged-in Chrome session.
